title: Feature Request: Android Wear Complication
body:
Hi,

I use the Android wear watch face for xDrip+ and it's handy.  It would be nice to have an Android Wear complication that could be used with any watch fact that would display the most recent blood glucose reading and maybe an arrow to indicate if the readings are rising, falling or steady.  It would also be great if we could tap on this complication to see a more detailed graph or readings over time.

I'm not sure how difficult this would be, but I think a lot of people would like this on both Wear and Apple Watch OS's.

comments.body: The complication is already available since quite a while. You just need to have a nightly build of xDrip and from an Android Wear 2.0 watch install the watch app through the app store. The complications are available then for watchfaces that support them.
